credential.title: Sign in to continue
credential.body: Paste the access credential the owner of this app gave you.

siwe.title: Connect your wallet
siwe.body: Sign a one-time message to show you own an allowed Ethereum address. It costs nothing.

email.title: Sign in with email
email.body: Enter your email address. If it has access to this app, you will get a one-time sign-in link.
